categories.evidence: Touches Miniscript typing rules in `src/script/miniscript.cpp`, which forms the descriptor parsing and analysis subsystem covered under descriptor management, matching the Descriptors label.
categories.rationale: Aligns Miniscript typing rules with the BIP-379 specification to resolve discrepancies against proposed test vectors. While the author notes the typing rule was 'mathematically equivalent for validity and malleability checking', fixing the edge-case divergence ensures cross-implementation consistency with BIP-379 test vectors.
